study.question: Can a typed, bounded observer remove the trace compatibility failure while preserving the inherited computation closely enough to justify a later same-source trajectory audit? Four r0021 attempts failed with the float32/64-only RuntimeError and exported no trace or validation; their summed receipt wall time is21.4754219353199s, with null training/GPU costs unknown. New source inspection of the hash-matching authorized r0021 modules shows that integer/bool tensors already reach the accepted else branch; the exact exception is raised only by is_floating_point() after float32/64 are excluded, including for empty tensors. Thus an unsupported floating dtype is the source-level failure condition, conditional on the exported source executing; the actual tensor name, dtype, shape and call site remain unobserved. Do not assert float16 labels as a fact. The scientific motivation remains unresolved replay fidelity: original M17 AUC0.6152795936767026 drops to0.6149279138846995 in its byte-identical seed42 replay; N replays0.6151021885074872. These full host jobs are counted compatibility/instrumentation calibrations, not a new architecture search or a completed duplicate-replay mechanism test.
study.hypothesis: The old serializer, rather than the permitted input identities or model computation, rejects a floating representation it cannot encode. Reinterpreting detached logical values as raw bytes, with named dtype/shape/stride/schema metadata, should handle float16/bfloat16 without changing values, and retain float32/64, bool and signed integer identities without lossy casts. A bounded call0 exact bit-preservation and same-graph complete-gradient gate, followed by trace-on versus exact historical trace-off controls for both M and N, can expose compatibility or instrumentation problems before any later duplicate-source replay claim. No repeatable magnitude performance benefit, semantic conflict mechanism, hardware root cause, independent equivalence or literature priority is predicted as established.

study.proposed_difference: Standalone trace_v2_magnitude/none preserve the r0021 inherited base and add only detached observation. Dtype codes1..10 map to bool,uint8,int8,int16,int32,int64,float16,bfloat16,float32,float64. Each component encodes schema2, ordered ordinal/name, dtype, ndim, full shape/strides and byte length before hashing native logical C-order raw bytes. No identity is converted numerically to float. Empty/scalar/noncontiguous logical tensors are covered; unsupported dtype/layout/device yields component/name/dtype/shape/call-counter detail rather than silent omission. At call0 deterministic artificial roundtrips cover the10 supported types, extrema, signed zero, infinities/NaN bits, empty/scalar/transposed cases. Actual inputs, labels, all parameters, logits, scalar loss and complete gradients then exercise the encoder. Saved input/parameter/logit/loss bytes must match exactly after observation. First/repeat/after complete-gradient probes use the same retained graph; reject if nonfinite or after-relative error exceeds max(4*repeat-relative error,1e-7). This numerical guard is prospective, not a scientific equivalence tolerance. The original result scalar/graph is returned unchanged. After that local gate, five training snapshots and an every-call static/label prefix are collected. Exactly64 scalar outputs include six actual dtype codes and gate results; original trace-off controls retain their63 inherited scalars. No live optimizer-state/update or independent forward gate is available; these must remain explicit gaps rather than being inferred from preserved raw gradients. All four files passed syntax/allowed-import/no-__setattr__ checks, unchanged inherited class and CONFIG-only paired-source checks; M/N trace-off hashes match original receipts. Torch is absent: none of the numerical gates, byte-view operations, host admission, latency or training is claimed executed. One local source-check harness assertion selected a renamed base class instead of the subclass after mutating its AST; the checker was corrected to normalize a deep copy and all source checks passed. Both attempts consume preparation budget. Before later whole-run repeatability attribution, review these four calibration outcomes and observed costs; do not bypass missing independent optimizer/input identity observations.
predictions: Typed byte-view roundtrip and actual-component encoding complete without the v1 floating-only error. Successful diagnostics identify actual labels/age/logit/loss dtypes by declared codes; if a failure remains, its named message localizes the unsupported representation. No dtype is inferred from receipt timing alone.

The local call0 gate reports exact input/logit/loss/parameter bit preservation, finite complete-gradient errors satisfying the prospective bound, and no creation-order/forward/optimizer/RNG edits under source review. Passing supports only this bounded candidate-authored observation path.

N trace-on/off should reproduce the previously stable aggregate and slice metrics if instrumentation is innocuous under this recipe. Any discrepancy prevents an exact reproduction claim; do not invent a post hoc metric tolerance.

M trace-on/off can differ even without an instrumentation effect because original same-source M already drifts. A single matched contrast is not causal attribution; stable N with unstable M only motivates later frozen-source duplicates, not a proven hardware or gradient mechanism.

Only after admissible repeated same-source observations may the first sampled mismatch narrow a component and interval: differing input sketches or initial parameter sketches block gradient-trajectory attribution; equal sketches leave collision and unobserved-state blind spots. No gain or generalization follows from successful tracing.
falsifiers: A remaining floating/layout/device error, byte roundtrip mismatch, omitted permitted component, changed metadata schema, nonfinite diagnostic or failure of the initial gate falsifies compatibility/nonperturbation for that observed path; preserve failures rather than rerunning unchanged code.
A source/init/order/forward/BCE/parameter-gradient intervention or frozen protocol change defeats the controlled observer comparison, even if validation improves.

Any N trace-on/off aggregate/slice mismatch prevents exact replay attribution. M disagreement alone is nonidentifying given its prior source-identical drift; matching aggregate metrics alone does not establish identical predictions.

A local gate cannot certify the live host gradient, Adam moments/updates or whole-run nonperturbation. Missing observations, checksum collisions and unsampled state prevent stronger conclusions even if all declared scalars pass.

No claim of a repeatable beneficial magnitude mechanism is supported by these seed42 calibration jobs; prior negative M-N/U/R outcomes remain. Such benefit would require frozen paired new-seed contrasts with uncertainty after integrity gates and adequate reserves.
alternative_explanations: A call0 read-only gate on the retained graph is candidate self-checking; it is not an independent trace-disabled forward reconstruction, a live host backward check or an Adam-state/update comparison.

Checksums are collision-prone two-prime sketches, not exact identities or cryptographic evidence. Exact equality is checked only inside the common-state gate; cross-run exact discrete identity is not certified by this export interface.

No exported optimizer state, host sample identity, original historical initialization/prediction/checkpoint tensors, deterministic settings or complete trajectory. Native byte-order portability, backing storage and aliasing are unverified.

Training instrumentation can perturb execution scheduling and numerical reductions. One trace-on/off comparison per intervention cannot distinguish instrumentation from intrinsic same-source instability, especially for magnitude.

Five states at calls0,1,512,8192,14660 are sparse samples before the host backward/step. Only states through the selected checkpoint survive. Every-call prefix covers static inputs and training labels, not all previous history contents.
Repeated same-graph gradients are not independent runs, independent initializations, independent mechanism contrasts or proof of correct live optimizer execution.

The rejected floating tensor could be labels, a model/gradient value, an empty tensor or another component; float16/bfloat16 are candidates, not observed causes. A different real dtype or layout may remain unsupported and should fail explicitly.

Historical drift may reflect unexported initialization/data order/checkpoint/host differences, rare late backward behavior, finite-precision accumulation, or adaptive validation/checkpoint selection. Source equality alone does not select among them.

Raw gradient magnitude allocation can change Adam conditioning without proving resolution of semantic query/history conflict. Round17 complete-row controls and round16 role-sum controls estimate different interventions.

Equal learned parameter counts and data passes are capacity/recipe controls, not equal measured compute. New checksum buffers, backward probes and synchronizations cost time and memory; no efficiency frontier is claimed.
